stem:
Meena is frying puris at home and notices that some puris puff up while others stay flat. She wants to investigate what makes a puri puff up.

She considers four features of her investigation:

1 the thickness of the rolled dough
2 the colour of the serving plate
3 the temperature of the oil
4 the smoke rising above the oil while frying

Which features are possible factors that may change how the puri puffs up?

teacher.key_rationale: Dough thickness (1), oil temperature (3) and smoke above the oil (4) are all features present during frying that may affect or accompany the puffing result, so they count as possible factors. The colour of the serving plate (2) is unrelated to the cooking process and cannot change how a puri puffs. Hence the keyed set is 1, 3 and 4, option C. Option A traps students who omit smoke, option B traps students who include the plate colour, and option D traps students who accept every listed feature.
